name: Havoc Heart
source:
Northern Illinois is a wasteland. You were surviving – until a snack run ended with a blow to the head. Now you’re trapped underground with a masked stranger who thinks you’re contaminated.

You’re not the first… just the first he’s kept alive. Figure out why – or die trying.

[From [url=https://fatality75.itch.io/havoc-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
